# opstracer_playbook_flow (Resource)

An investigation playbook flow: a graph of playbooks and conditions that runs when an incident opens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Building blocks: GET /api/v1/investigation/playbook-flow/catalog.
resource "opstracer_playbook_flow" "database" {
  name        = "database-first"
  description = "Check the database before anything else"
  graph = jsonencode({
    nodes = [
      { id = "incident", type = "incident", position = { x = 0, y = 0 } },
      { id = "db", type = "playbook", playbook = "database", position = { x = 250, y = 0 }, values = { env = "prod" } },
      { id = "end", type = "end", position = { x = 500, y = 0 } },
    ]
    edges = [
      { source = "incident", source_handle = "start", target = "db", target_handle = "after" },
      { source = "db", source_handle = "done", target = "end", target_handle = "after" },
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph` (String) Flow graph as JSON, `{nodes = [...], edges = [...]}`; build it with `jsonencode()`. Node `type` is `incident`, `playbook`, `condition`, `end` or `topology`; edges use `source_handle` and `target_handle`. The building blocks are listed by `GET /api/v1/investigation/playbook-flow/catalog`. Key order, whitespace and empty fields (`values = {}`, `playbook = null`) do not cause diffs, except right after import, where a `jsonencode()` value that leaves empty fields out matches exactly.
- `name` (String) Flow name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `visibility` (String) `org` (everyone in the org) or `private` (only the token's user). Defaults to `org`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Playbook flow ID.
- `version` (Number) Server-side revision, bumped on every update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_playbook_flow.database <playbook-flow-id>
```
